admission: Ordinary same-parent groups of 1 to 8. A ready subset requires unique accounting C0, the pinned original worker and its actual natural return, fresh independent device admission, existing project lock and publication checks.
approval: Existing user instruction and ordinary Git publication before GPU actions. No changes to parent allocations, other jobs, planned workload service or automation.
calendar_derivation: Published prior 70-node independently verified same-PCI worker leases.
lease: Qualified preemptible BF16 standby per admitted project node. Each standby Slurm budget is at most 10800 seconds.
priority: Existing active or ready higher priority work is preserved.
unknown_policy: Keep original request and reservation. Only consume actual original status; never replay an unconfirmed operation. A new reservation requires positive hash-bound no-send evidence.
